# Rahmet Labs

> Rahmet Labs is a full-stack technology studio in Almaty, Kazakhstan. We replace
> manual business operations with engineered systems: business automation, AI
> agents wired into real workflows, web and mobile products, backend/data
> infrastructure, and production Web3 systems. One accountable team scopes,
> builds, and operates what ships — in English, Russian, and Kazakh.

## What we do

- **Business automation** — workflows that run without a human in the loop:
  approvals, invoicing, reporting, tender monitoring, CRM/ERP synchronization.
- **AI systems** — agents, RAG over private company data, content pipelines,
  matching and scoring; integrated into operations, not demo chatbots.
- **Web & mobile products** — marketing systems, SaaS platforms, consumer apps;
  designed, built, and shipped end to end.
- **Backend & data** — APIs, Postgres/Supabase data layers, auth, monitoring.
- **Web3 & blockchain** — Solidity contracts, multi-chain deployment (ETH, BSC,
  Arbitrum), multi-sig pipelines, on-chain monitoring.

## How engagements work

- Fixed-cost pilot (roughly 2–4 weeks). If the first sprint does not deliver a
  usable artifact, the engagement stops — no lock-in, no retainer required.
- Typical timeline: 1–2 weeks to first milestone; full systems 3–8 weeks
  depending on scope.
- Repositories, infrastructure, and documentation are handed over to the client
  on delivery — no hostage holding.
- Direct communication with the engineers building the system; no account
  manager relay.

## Who we work with

Founders and operators running manual operations — SMEs and startups in
Kazakhstan, Central Asia, Europe, and the Gulf. Optimal first evidence of fit:
an existing revenue or product and a manual process someone does daily.

## Work and evidence

- Systems for education, retail, logistics, and public-sector adjacent clients.
- Live portfolio and technical walkthroughs: https://rahmetlabs.com/en/portfolio
- Multilingual: English, Russian, and Kazakh versions of all pages and
  deliverables.
